## 8a802749348c

**Reproduced defect: portable task-test root calculation.** Generator SHA-256 `edb5053c6281505461056b84bfb5723fda7d695c5da3a7fa6265e48cdb71226d` was not modified.

The official source-bound task-test stage ran 20 tests: 17 passed and 3 failed. All three failures occur before semantic assertions because `tests/test_generator_8a802749348c.py` defines `ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]` and then opens `ROOT / "data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl"`. In the portable runtime that becomes `<runtime>/generators/8a802749348c/data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl`; canonical data is staged at `<runtime>/data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl`.

Affected tests are the selected-authority hash test, six-canonical-pair parity test, and Racket A-B-A purity test. The other 17 tests—including deterministic generation, exact override boundaries, lesson competitor refutation, witness/rival disagreements, and targeted invalid-input rejection—passed. I did not infer that the three intended semantic checks would pass once their data path is repaired; they remain unexecuted. Use the portable canonical helpers documented in `repo/shared/README.md` rather than a source-depth guess.

Evidence: `checks/audit-8a802749348c-task-tests/result.json` and compact `checks/audit-8a802749348c-summary.json`.
